One sentence: **the quality-gate toolchain runs crap4dart 0.14.2 everywhere the gate executes — CI, pre-commit, local — with the same threshold and a strictly non-weakened gate set.**
Today every gate run activates crap4dart 0.9.5 (pinned in ONE place: `.github/workflows/quality.yml:258`). Upstream is 0.14.2 (pub.dev latest; 0.9.5→0.14.2 spans 0.12.x/0.13.x/0.14.x — config/CLI/output changes possible). The bump must land as ONE reviewable change with evidence that the gate got STRICTER-or-equal, never looser.

## Why this framing
- "Bump the version" alone is retracted: the SUBJECT of every step is the GATE CHAIN (CI activate + check + analyze + badge, pre-commit `check --staged`, local install), not the analyzed code.
- "Fix new findings first" is retracted: new-version CRAP math MAY flag new hotspots; those are follow-up parity work items (like agents CRAP issues #925-#930), NOT a reason to weaken the threshold or defer the bump.

## Architecture (named, with invariants)
- **Pin sites (exhaustive inventory, verify each):** CI `.github/workflows/quality.yml:258` (`dart pub global activate crap4dart 0.9.5`), the same file's `check --all` (l.259) / `analyze` (l.261) / badge step (l.293-296), the pre-commit hook (`crap4dart check --staged`), README/AGENTS.md mentions, any local bootstrap scripts.
- **Invariant I1:** threshold stays **8.0** (`crap4dart.yaml` — GOAL.md: "do not raise").
- **Invariant I2:** `sources: [lib, bin, test]` unchanged; coverage `required: true` unchanged.
- **Invariant I3:** local and CI versions are ALWAYS in sync (AGENTS.md rule) — one PR flips both or neither.
- **Invariant I4:** no gate is weakened, skipped, or `continue-on-error`'d to make 0.14.2 pass.
- **Fallback:** if 0.14.2 has a breaking regression (config unparseable, false-positive CRAP explosion from a tool bug — distinguish from REAL new findings), fall back to the newest version that passes cleanly and document the blocker as a separate issue; never pin an intermediate version silently.

## Capability surface (what the bump touches)
| Surface | Change | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| CI activate pin | 0.9.5 → 0.14.2 | single line |
| CLI surface | verify `check --staged`, `check --all`, `analyze --coverage=`, `init`, `install` still exist with same semantics | changelog diff 0.9.5→0.14.2 |
| Config schema | `crap4dart.yaml` parses under 0.14.2 unchanged | if schema moved: migrate config in the SAME PR, threshold preserved |
| Coverage chain | `dart test --coverage` → `format_coverage` → `crap4dart analyze --coverage=` still wire up | watch the lcov filter list (quality.yml ~l.159-172) |
| Badge | CRAP badge still computed/emitted | threshold text stays 8.0 |
| Pre-commit | hook runs 0.14.2 | sync = I3 |
| Findings delta | NEW findings from stricter math = listed, filed as follow-ups | NOT fixed in this PR unless trivial |

**Core:** version bump + full-chain verification + findings inventory. **Second tier:** follow-up CRAP fixes (separate items). **Excluded:** changing the threshold, exclusions, or gate order (rationale: the gate set is the product; the tool version is not).

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- **AC1** — `grep -rn "0\.9\.5" .github/ scripts/` returns zero crap4dart hits after the PR (pin fully moved).
- **AC2** — CI quality run green on the PR head with 0.14.2 active (activate line shows 0.14.2 in logs; `check --all` + `analyze` exit 0).
- **AC3** — `crap4dart.yaml` unchanged OR migrated with `crap.threshold: 8.0` byte-identical.
- **AC4** — findings delta documented in the PR body: CRAP max/score before vs after (expect equal or the delta listed as follow-up issues).
- **AC5** — pre-commit hook version-synced (hook output or docs evidence).
- **AC6** — full standing gate sequence green: format → analyze → test → coverage ≥ 80% → crap4dart check --all → crap4dart analyze → agents suite (unchanged by this bump).

## Test plan
- **UT-1:** config parse: `crap4dart` reads repo `crap4dart.yaml` under 0.14.2 (exit 0, threshold echoed 8.0). (AC3)
- **IT-1:** CLI surface smoke on a fixture tree: `check --staged` on a staged clean change (exit 0) and on a staged CRAP-heavy fixture (exit 2) — proves the exit-code contract is preserved. (AC2)
- **IT-2:** coverage chain: `analyze --coverage=` consumes the lcov produced by the current quality.yml filter chain. (AC2, AC6)
- **E2E-1:** the PR's own CI run = the real gate on the real tree with 0.14.2. (AC2, AC6)
- **REG-1:** CRAP-score drift guard: max CRAP before vs after on main — equal or better, else the delta is enumerated (never silent). A red REG-1 blocks merge even when all other jobs are green. (AC4)
- **REG-2:** agents suite result identical baseline (751/751-class pass) — the bump must not touch the runtime. (AC6)

### Edge cases
- **E1** — 0.14.2 rejects `crap4dart.yaml`: migrate config in-PR, threshold byte-identical (I1); if migration impossible, fallback rule applies.
- **E2** — CRAP math changes flag EXISTING code > 8.0: file follow-ups, do not bump threshold (I4); gate stays red only if follow-ups are not acceptable to the owner — escalate, don't decide alone.
- **E3** — pub global activate fails on CI's dart SDK (SDK constraint): pin the tool's compatible dart SDK in the same PR, document in PR body.

## Non-goals
- No threshold/exclusion/gate-order changes. No CRAP refactors of flagged code (follow-ups). No switch to a different CRAP tool.

## Open questions
- None blocking; if 0.14.2 proves incompatible (E1/E3), the fallback question goes back to the owner with evidence.

## References
- AGENTS.md (pin-sync rule, gate sequence), GOAL.md Phase-0/2 (threshold law)

# gh-425: Upgrade crap4dart 0.9.5 -> 0.14.2 (quality-gate toolchain bump, zero gate weakening)

## Description

## Goal — crap4dart 0.14.2 (v1)
One sentence: **the quality-gate toolchain runs crap4dart 0.14.2 everywhere the gate executes — CI, pre-commit, local — with the same threshold and a strictly non-weakened gate set.**
Today every gate run activates crap4dart 0.9.5 (pinned in ONE place: `.github/workflows/quality.yml:258`). Upstream is 0.14.2 (pub.dev latest; 0.9.5→0.14.2 spans 0.12.x/0.13.x/0.14.x — config/CLI/output changes possible). The bump must land as ONE reviewable change with evidence that the gate got STRICTER-or-equal, never looser.

## Why this framing
- "Bump the version" alone is retracted: the SUBJECT of every step is the GATE CHAIN (CI activate + check + analyze + badge, pre-commit `check --staged`, local install), not the analyzed code.
- "Fix new findings first" is retracted: new-version CRAP math MAY flag new hotspots; those are follow-up parity work items (like agents CRAP issues #925-#930), NOT a reason to weaken the threshold or defer the bump.

## Architecture (named, with invariants)
- **Pin sites (exhaustive inventory, verify each):** CI `.github/workflows/quality.yml:258` (`dart pub global activate crap4dart 0.9.5`), the same file's `check --all` (l.259) / `analyze` (l.261) / badge step (l.293-296), the pre-commit hook (`crap4dart check --staged`), README/AGENTS.md mentions, any local bootstrap scripts.
- **Invariant I1:** threshold stays **8.0** (`crap4dart.yaml` — GOAL.md: "do not raise").
- **Invariant I2:** `sources: [lib, bin, test]` unchanged; coverage `required: true` unchanged.
- **Invariant I3:** local and CI versions are ALWAYS in sync (AGENTS.md rule) — one PR flips both or neither.
- **Invariant I4:** no gate is weakened, skipped, or `continue-on-error`'d to make 0.14.2 pass.
- **Fallback:** if 0.14.2 has a breaking regression (config unparseable, false-positive CRAP explosion from a tool bug — distinguish from REAL new findings), fall back to the newest version that passes cleanly and document the blocker as a separate issue; never pin an intermediate version silently.

## Capability surface (what the bump touches)
| Surface | Change | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| CI activate pin | 0.9.5 → 0.14.2 | single line |
| CLI surface | verify `check --staged`, `check --all`, `analyze --coverage=`, `init`, `install` still exist with same semantics | changelog diff 0.9.5→0.14.2 |
| Config schema | `crap4dart.yaml` parses under 0.14.2 unchanged | if schema moved: migrate config in the SAME PR, threshold preserved |
| Coverage chain | `dart test --coverage` → `format_coverage` → `crap4dart analyze --coverage=` still wire up | watch the lcov filter list (quality.yml ~l.159-172) |
| Badge | CRAP badge still computed/emitted | threshold text stays 8.0 |
| Pre-commit | hook runs 0.14.2 | sync = I3 |
| Findings delta | NEW findings from stricter math = listed, filed as follow-ups | NOT fixed in this PR unless trivial |

**Core:** version bump + full-chain verification + findings inventory. **Second tier:** follow-up CRAP fixes (separate items). **Excluded:** changing the threshold, exclusions, or gate order (rationale: the gate set is the product; the tool version is not).

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- **AC1** — `grep -rn "0\.9\.5" .github/ scripts/` returns zero crap4dart hits after the PR (pin fully moved).
- **AC2** — CI quality run green on the PR head with 0.14.2 active (activate line shows 0.14.2 in logs; `check --all` + `analyze` exit 0).
- **AC3** — `crap4dart.yaml` unchanged OR migrated with `crap.threshold: 8.0` byte-identical.
- **AC4** — findings delta documented in the PR body: CRAP max/score before vs after (expect equal or the delta listed as follow-up issues).
- **AC5** — pre-commit hook version-synced (hook output or docs evidence).
- **AC6** — full standing gate sequence green: format → analyze → test → coverage ≥ 80% → crap4dart check --all → crap4dart analyze → agents suite (unchanged by this bump).

## Test plan
- **UT-1:** config parse: `crap4dart` reads repo `crap4dart.yaml` under 0.14.2 (exit 0, threshold echoed 8.0). (AC3)
- **IT-1:** CLI surface smoke on a fixture tree: `check --staged` on a staged clean change (exit 0) and on a staged CRAP-heavy fixture (exit 2) — proves the exit-code contract is preserved. (AC2)
- **IT-2:** coverage chain: `analyze --coverage=` consumes the lcov produced by the current quality.yml filter chain. (AC2, AC6)
- **E2E-1:** the PR's own CI run = the real gate on the real tree with 0.14.2. (AC2, AC6)
- **REG-1:** CRAP-score drift guard: max CRAP before vs after on main — equal or better, else the delta is enumerated (never silent). A red REG-1 blocks merge even when all other jobs are green. (AC4)
- **REG-2:** agents suite result identical baseline (751/751-class pass) — the bump must not touch the runtime. (AC6)

### Edge cases
- **E1** — 0.14.2 rejects `crap4dart.yaml`: migrate config in-PR, threshold byte-identical (I1); if migration impossible, fallback rule applies.
- **E2** — CRAP math changes flag EXISTING code > 8.0: file follow-ups, do not bump threshold (I4); gate stays red only if follow-ups are not acceptable to the owner — escalate, don't decide alone.
- **E3** — pub global activate fails on CI's dart SDK (SDK constraint): pin the tool's compatible dart SDK in the same PR, document in PR body.

## Non-goals
- No threshold/exclusion/gate-order changes. No CRAP refactors of flagged code (follow-ups). No switch to a different CRAP tool.

## Open questions
- None blocking; if 0.14.2 proves incompatible (E1/E3), the fallback question goes back to the owner with evidence.

## References
- AGENTS.md (pin-sync rule, gate sequence), GOAL.md Phase-0/2 (threshold law)
- Pin site: `.github/workflows/quality.yml:258`
- Upstream: https://pub.dev/packages/crap4dart (latest 0.14.2)

## Description

## Goal — crap4dart 0.14.2 (v1)
One sentence: **the quality-gate toolchain runs crap4dart 0.14.2 everywhere the gate executes — CI, pre-commit, local — with the same threshold and a strictly non-weakened gate set.**
Today every gate run activates crap4dart 0.9.5 (pinned in ONE place: `.github/workflows/quality.yml:258`). Upstream is 0.14.2 (pub.dev latest; 0.9.5→0.14.2 spans 0.12.x/0.13.x/0.14.x — config/CLI/output changes possible). The bump must land as ONE reviewable change with evidence that the gate got STRICTER-or-equal, never looser.

## Why this framing
- "Bump the version" alone is retracted: the SUBJECT of every step is the GATE CHAIN (CI activate + check + analyze + badge, pre-commit `check --staged`, local install), not the analyzed code.
- "Fix new findings first" is retracted: new-version CRAP math MAY flag new hotspots; those are follow-up parity work items (like agents CRAP issues #925-#930), NOT a reason to weaken the threshold or defer the bump.

## Architecture (named, with invariants)
- **Pin sites (exhaustive inventory, verify each):** CI `.github/workflows/quality.yml:258` (`dart pub global activate crap4dart 0.9.5`), the same file's `check --all` (l.259) / `analyze` (l.261) / badge step (l.293-296), the pre-commit hook (`crap4dart check --staged`), README/AGENTS.md mentions, any local bootstrap scripts.
- **Invariant I1:** threshold stays **8.0** (`crap4dart.yaml` — GOAL.md: "do not raise").
- **Invariant I2:** `sources: [lib, bin, test]` unchanged; coverage `required: true` unchanged.
- **Invariant I3:** local and CI versions are ALWAYS in sync (AGENTS.md rule) — one PR flips both or neither.
- **Invariant I4:** no gate is weakened, skipped, or `continue-on-error`'d to make 0.14.2 pass.
- **Fallback:** if 0.14.2 has a breaking regression (config unparseable, false-positive CRAP explosion from a tool bug — distinguish from REAL new findings), fall back to the newest version that passes cleanly and document the blocker as a separate issue; never pin an intermediate version silently.

## Capability surface (what the bump touches)
| Surface | Change | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| CI activate pin | 0.9.5 → 0.14.2 | single line |
| CLI surface | verify `check --staged`, `check --all`, `analyze --coverage=`, `init`, `install` still exist with same semantics | changelog diff 0.9.5→0.14.2 |
| Config schema | `crap4dart.yaml` parses under 0.14.2 unchanged | if schema moved: migrate config in the SAME PR, threshold preserved |
| Coverage chain | `dart test --coverage` → `format_coverage` → `crap4dart analyze --coverage=` still wire up | watch the lcov filter list (quality.yml ~l.159-172) |
| Badge | CRAP badge still computed/emitted | threshold text stays 8.0 |
| Pre-commit | hook runs 0.14.2 | sync = I3 |
| Findings delta | NEW findings from stricter math = listed, filed as follow-ups | NOT fixed in this PR unless trivial |

**Core:** version bump + full-chain verification + findings inventory. **Second tier:** follow-up CRAP fixes (separate items). **Excluded:** changing the threshold, exclusions, or gate order (rationale: the gate set is the product; the tool version is not).

- **AC1** — `grep -rn "0\.9\.5" .github/ scripts/` returns zero crap4dart hits after the PR (pin fully moved).
- **AC2** — CI quality run green on the PR head with 0.14.2 active (activate line shows 0.14.2 in logs; `check --all` + `analyze` exit 0).
- **AC3** — `crap4dart.yaml` unchanged OR migrated with `crap.threshold: 8.0` byte-identical.
- **AC4** — findings delta documented in the PR body: CRAP max/score before vs after (expect equal or the delta listed as follow-up issues).
- **AC5** — pre-commit hook version-synced (hook output or docs evidence).
- **AC6** — full standing gate sequence green: format → analyze → test → coverage ≥ 80% → crap4dart check --all → crap4dart analyze → agents suite (unchanged by this bump).

## Test plan
- **UT-1:** config parse: `crap4dart` reads repo `crap4dart.yaml` under 0.14.2 (exit 0, threshold echoed 8.0). (AC3)

- **REG-1:** CRAP-score drift guard: max CRAP before vs after on main — equal or better, else the delta is enumerated (never silent). A red REG-1 blocks merge even when all other jobs are green. (AC4)
- **REG-2:** agents suite result identical baseline (751/751-class pass) — the bump must not touch the runtime. (AC6)

### Edge cases
- **E1** — 0.14.2 rejects `crap4dart.yaml`: migrate config in-PR, threshold byte-identical (I1); if migration impossible, fallback rule applies.
- **E2** — CRAP math changes flag EXISTING code > 8.0: file follow-ups, do not bump threshold (I4); gate stays red only if follow-ups are not acceptable to the owner — escalate, don't decide alone.
- **E3** — pub global activate fails on CI's dart SDK (SDK constraint): pin the tool's compatible dart SDK in the same PR, document in PR body.

## Non-goals
- No threshold/exclusion/gate-order changes. No CRAP refactors of flagged code (follow-ups). No switch to a different CRAP tool.

## Open questions
- None blocking; if 0.14.2 proves incompatible (E1/E3), the fallback question goes back to the owner with evidence.

# gh-425: Upgrade crap4dart 0.9.5 -> 0.14.2 (quality-gate toolchain bump, zero gate weakening)

## Description

## Goal — crap4dart 0.14.2 (v1)
One sentence: **the quality-gate toolchain runs crap4dart 0.14.2 everywhere the gate executes — CI, pre-commit, local — with the same threshold and a strictly non-weakened gate set.**
Today every gate run activates crap4dart 0.9.5 (pinned in ONE place: `.github/workflows/quality.yml:258`). Upstream is 0.14.2 (pub.dev latest; 0.9.5→0.14.2 spans 0.12.x/0.13.x/0.14.x — config/CLI/output changes possible). The bump must land as ONE reviewable change with evidence that the gate got STRICTER-or-equal, never looser.

## Why this framing
- "Bump the version" alone is retracted: the SUBJECT of every step is the GATE CHAIN (CI activate + check + analyze + badge, pre-commit `check --staged`, local install), not the analyzed code.
- "Fix new findings first" is retracted: new-version CRAP math MAY flag new hotspots; those are follow-up parity work items (like agents CRAP issues #925-#930), NOT a reason to weaken the threshold or defer the bump.

## Architecture (named, with invariants)
- **Pin sites (exhaustive inventory, verify each):** CI `.github/workflows/quality.yml:258` (`dart pub global activate crap4dart 0.9.5`), the same file's `check --all` (l.259) / `analyze` (l.261) / badge step (l.293-296), the pre-commit hook (`crap4dart check --staged`), README/AGENTS.md mentions, any local bootstrap scripts.
- **Invariant I1:** threshold stays **8.0** (`crap4dart.yaml` — GOAL.md: "do not raise").
- **Invariant I2:** `sources: [lib, bin, test]` unchanged; coverage `required: true` unchanged.
- **Invariant I3:** local and CI versions are ALWAYS in sync (AGENTS.md rule) — one PR flips both or neither.
- **Invariant I4:** no gate is weakened, skipped, or `continue-on-error`'d to make 0.14.2 pass.
- **Fallback:** if 0.14.2 has a breaking regression (config unparseable, false-positive CRAP explosion from a tool bug — distinguish from REAL new findings), fall back to the newest version that passes cleanly and document the blocker as a separate issue; never pin an intermediate version silently.

## Capability surface (what the bump touches)
| Surface | Change | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| CI activate pin | 0.9.5 → 0.14.2 | single line |
| CLI surface | verify `check --staged`, `check --all`, `analyze --coverage=`, `init`, `install` still exist with same semantics | changelog diff 0.9.5→0.14.2 |
| Config schema | `crap4dart.yaml` parses under 0.14.2 unchanged | if schema moved: migrate config in the SAME PR, threshold preserved |
| Coverage chain | `dart test --coverage` → `format_coverage` → `crap4dart analyze --coverage=` still wire up | watch the lcov filter list (quality.yml ~l.159-172) |
| Badge | CRAP badge still computed/emitted | threshold text stays 8.0 |
| Pre-commit | hook runs 0.14.2 | sync = I3 |
| Findings delta | NEW findings from stricter math = listed, filed as follow-ups | NOT fixed in this PR unless trivial |

**Core:** version bump + full-chain verification + findings inventory. **Second tier:** follow-up CRAP fixes (separate items). **Excluded:** changing the threshold, exclusions, or gate order (rationale: the gate set is the product; the tool version is not).

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- **AC1** — `grep -rn "0\.9\.5" .github/ scripts/` returns zero crap4dart hits after the PR (pin fully moved).
- **AC2** — CI quality run green on the PR head with 0.14.2 active (activate line shows 0.14.2 in logs; `check --all` + `analyze` exit 0).
- **AC3** — `crap4dart.yaml` unchanged OR migrated with `crap.threshold: 8.0` byte-identical.
- **AC4** — findings delta documented in the PR body: CRAP max/score before vs after (expect equal or the delta listed as follow-up issues).
- **AC5** — pre-commit hook version-synced (hook output or docs evidence).
- **AC6** — full standing gate sequence green: format → analyze → test → coverage ≥ 80% → crap4dart check --all → crap4dart analyze → agents suite (unchanged by this bump).

## Test plan
- **UT-1:** config parse: `crap4dart` reads repo `crap4dart.yaml` under 0.14.2 (exit 0, threshold echoed 8.0). (AC3)
- **IT-1:** CLI surface smoke on a fixture tree: `check --staged` on a staged clean change (exit 0) and on a staged CRAP-heavy fixture (exit 2) — proves the exit-code contract is preserved. (AC2)
- **IT-2:** coverage chain: `analyze --coverage=` consumes the lcov produced by the current quality.yml filter chain. (AC2, AC6)
- **E2E-1:** the PR's own CI run = the real gate on the real tree with 0.14.2. (AC2, AC6)
- **REG-1:** CRAP-score drift guard: max CRAP before vs after on main — equal or better, else the delta is enumerated (never silent). A red REG-1 blocks merge even when all other jobs are green. (AC4)
- **REG-2:** agents suite result identical baseline (751/751-class pass) — the bump must not touch the runtime. (AC6)

### Edge cases
- **E1** — 0.14.2 rejects `crap4dart.yaml`: migrate config in-PR, threshold byte-identical (I1); if migration impossible, fallback rule applies.
- **E2** — CRAP math changes flag EXISTING code > 8.0: file follow-ups, do not bump threshold (I4); gate stays red only if follow-ups are not acceptable to the owner — escalate, don't decide alone.
- **E3** — pub global activate fails on CI's dart SDK (SDK constraint): pin the tool's compatible dart SDK in the same PR, document in PR body.

## Non-goals
- No threshold/exclusion/gate-order changes. No CRAP refactors of flagged code (follow-ups). No switch to a different CRAP tool.

## Open questions
- None blocking; if 0.14.2 proves incompatible (E1/E3), the fallback question goes back to the owner with evidence.

## References
- AGENTS.md (pin-sync rule, gate sequence), GOAL.md Phase-0/2 (threshold law)
- Pin site: `.github/workflows/quality.yml:258`
- Upstream: https://pub.dev/packages/crap4dart (latest 0.14.2)

## Description

## Goal — crap4dart 0.14.2 (v1)
One sentence: **the quality-gate toolchain runs crap4dart 0.14.2 everywhere the gate executes — CI, pre-commit, local — with the same threshold and a strictly non-weakened gate set.**
Today every gate run activates crap4dart 0.9.5 (pinned in ONE place: `.github/workflows/quality.yml:258`). Upstream is 0.14.2 (pub.dev latest; 0.9.5→0.14.2 spans 0.12.x/0.13.x/0.14.x — config/CLI/output changes possible). The bump must land as ONE reviewable change with evidence that the gate got STRICTER-or-equal, never looser.

## Why this framing
- "Bump the version" alone is retracted: the SUBJECT of every step is the GATE CHAIN (CI activate + check + analyze + badge, pre-commit `check --staged`, local install), not the analyzed code.
- "Fix new findings first" is retracted: new-version CRAP math MAY flag new hotspots; those are follow-up parity work items (like agents CRAP issues #925-#930), NOT a reason to weaken the threshold or defer the bump.

## Architecture (named, with invariants)
- **Pin sites (exhaustive inventory, verify each):** CI `.github/workflows/quality.yml:258` (`dart pub global activate crap4dart 0.9.5`), the same file's `check --all` (l.259) / `analyze` (l.261) / badge step (l.293-296), the pre-commit hook (`crap4dart check --staged`), README/AGENTS.md mentions, any local bootstrap scripts.
- **Invariant I1:** threshold stays **8.0** (`crap4dart.yaml` — GOAL.md: "do not raise").
- **Invariant I2:** `sources: [lib, bin, test]` unchanged; coverage `required: true` unchanged.
- **Invariant I3:** local and CI versions are ALWAYS in sync (AGENTS.md rule) — one PR flips both or neither.
- **Invariant I4:** no gate is weakened, skipped, or `continue-on-error`'d to make 0.14.2 pass.
- **Fallback:** if 0.14.2 has a breaking regression (config unparseable, false-positive CRAP explosion from a tool bug — distinguish from REAL new findings), fall back to the newest version that passes cleanly and document the blocker as a separate issue; never pin an intermediate version silently.

## Capability surface (what the bump touches)
| Surface | Change | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| CI activate pin | 0.9.5 → 0.14.2 | single line |
| CLI surface | verify `check --staged`, `check --all`, `analyze --coverage=`, `init`, `install` still exist with same semantics | changelog diff 0.9.5→0.14.2 |
| Config schema | `crap4dart.yaml` parses under 0.14.2 unchanged | if schema moved: migrate config in the SAME PR, threshold preserved |
| Coverage chain | `dart test --coverage` → `format_coverage` → `crap4dart analyze --coverage=` still wire up | watch the lcov filter list (quality.yml ~l.159-172) |
| Badge | CRAP badge still computed/emitted | threshold text stays 8.0 |
| Pre-commit | hook runs 0.14.2 | sync = I3 |
| Findings delta | NEW findings from stricter math = listed, filed as follow-ups | NOT fixed in this PR unless trivial |

**Core:** version bump + full-chain verification + findings inventory. **Second tier:** follow-up CRAP fixes (separate items). **Excluded:** changing the threshold, exclusions, or gate order (rationale: the gate set is the product; the tool version is not).

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- **AC1** — `grep -rn "0\.9\.5" .github/ scripts/` returns zero crap4dart hits after the PR (pin fully moved).
- **AC2** — CI quality run green on the PR head with 0.14.2 active (activate line shows 0.14.2 in logs; `check --all` + `analyze` exit 0).
- **AC3** — `crap4dart.yaml` unchanged OR migrated with `crap.threshold: 8.0` byte-identical.
- **AC4** — findings delta documented in the PR body: CRAP max/score before vs after (expect equal or the delta listed as follow-up issues).
- **AC5** — pre-commit hook version-synced (hook output or docs evidence).
- **AC6** — full standing gate sequence green: format → analyze → test → coverage ≥ 80% → crap4dart check --all → crap4dart analyze → agents suite (unchanged by this bump).

## Test plan
- **UT-1:** config parse: `crap4dart` reads repo `crap4dart.yaml` under 0.14.2 (exit 0, threshold echoed 8.0). (AC3)
- **IT-1:** CLI surface smoke on a fixture tree: `check --staged` on a staged clean change (exit 0) and on a staged CRAP-heavy fixture (exit 2) — proves the exit-code contract is preserved. (AC2)
- **IT-2:** coverage chain: `analyze --coverage=` consumes the lcov produced by the current quality.yml filter chain. (AC2, AC6)
- **E2E-1:** the PR's own CI run = the real gate on the real tree with 0.14.2. (AC2, AC6)
- **REG-1:** CRAP-score drift guard: max CRAP before vs after on main — equal or better, else the delta is enumerated (never silent). A red REG-1 blocks merge even when all other jobs are green. (AC4)
- **REG-2:** agents suite result identical baseline (751/751-class pass) — the bump must not touch the runtime. (AC6)

### Edge cases
- **E1** — 0.14.2 rejects `crap4dart.yaml`: migrate config in-PR, threshold byte-identical (I1); if migration impossible, fallback rule applies.
- **E2** — CRAP math changes flag EXISTING code > 8.0: file follow-ups, do not bump threshold (I4); gate stays red only if follow-ups are not acceptable to the owner — escalate, don't decide alone.
- **E3** — pub global activate fails on CI's dart SDK (SDK constraint): pin the tool's compatible dart SDK in the same PR, document in PR body.

## Non-goals
- No threshold/exclusion/gate-order changes. No CRAP refactors of flagged code (follow-ups). No switch to a different CRAP tool.

## Open questions
- None blocking; if 0.14.2 proves incompatible (E1/E3), the fallback question goes back to the owner with evidence.

## References
- AGENTS.md (pin-sync rule, gate sequence), GOAL.md Phase-0/2 (threshold law)
- Pin site: `.github/workflows/quality.yml:258`
- Upstream: https://pub.dev/packages/crap4dart (latest 0.14.2)

# gh-425: Upgrade crap4dart 0.9.5 -> 0.14.2 (quality-gate toolchain bump, zero gate weakening)

## Description

## Goal — crap4dart 0.14.2 (v1)
One sentence: **the quality-gate toolchain runs crap4dart 0.14.2 everywhere the gate executes — CI, pre-commit, local — with the same threshold and a strictly non-weakened gate set.**
Today every gate run activates crap4dart 0.9.5 (pinned in ONE place: `.github/workflows/quality.yml:258`). Upstream is 0.14.2 (pub.dev latest; 0.9.5→0.14.2 spans 0.12.x/0.13.x/0.14.x — config/CLI/output changes possible). The bump must land as ONE reviewable change with evidence that the gate got STRICTER-or-equal, never looser.

## Why this framing
- "Bump the version" alone is retracted: the SUBJECT of every step is the GATE CHAIN (CI activate + check + analyze + badge, pre-commit `check --staged`, local install), not the analyzed code.
- "Fix new findings first" is retracted: new-version CRAP math MAY flag new hotspots; those are follow-up parity work items (like agents CRAP issues #925-#930), NOT a reason to weaken the threshold or defer the bump.

## Architecture (named, with invariants)
- **Pin sites (exhaustive inventory, verify each):** CI `.github/workflows/quality.yml:258` (`dart pub global activate crap4dart 0.9.5`), the same file's `check --all` (l.259) / `analyze` (l.261) / badge step (l.293-296), the pre-commit hook (`crap4dart check --staged`), README/AGENTS.md mentions, any local bootstrap scripts.
- **Invariant I1:** threshold stays **8.0** (`crap4dart.yaml` — GOAL.md: "do not raise").
- **Invariant I2:** `sources: [lib, bin, test]` unchanged; coverage `required: true` unchanged.
- **Invariant I3:** local and CI versions are ALWAYS in sync (AGENTS.md rule) — one PR flips both or neither.
- **Invariant I4:** no gate is weakened, skipped, or `continue-on-error`'d to make 0.14.2 pass.
- **Fallback:** if 0.14.2 has a breaking regression (config unparseable, false-positive CRAP explosion from a tool bug — distinguish from REAL new findings), fall back to the newest version that passes cleanly and document the blocker as a separate issue; never pin an intermediate version silently.

## Capability surface (what the bump touches)
| Surface | Change | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| CI activate pin | 0.9.5 → 0.14.2 | single line |
| CLI surface | verify `check --staged`, `check --all`, `analyze --coverage=`, `init`, `install` still exist with same semantics | changelog diff 0.9.5→0.14.2 |
| Config schema | `crap4dart.yaml` parses under 0.14.2 unchanged | if schema moved: migrate config in the SAME PR, threshold preserved |
| Coverage chain | `dart test --coverage` → `format_coverage` → `crap4dart analyze --coverage=` still wire up | watch the lcov filter list (quality.yml ~l.159-172) |
| Badge | CRAP badge still computed/emitted | threshold text stays 8.0 |
| Pre-commit | hook runs 0.14.2 | sync = I3 |
| Findings delta | NEW findings from stricter math = listed, filed as follow-ups | NOT fixed in this PR unless trivial |

**Core:** version bump + full-chain verification + findings inventory. **Second tier:** follow-up CRAP fixes (separate items). **Excluded:** changing the threshold, exclusions, or gate order (rationale: the gate set is the product; the tool version is not).

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- **AC1** — `grep -rn "0\.9\.5" .github/ scripts/` returns zero crap4dart hits after the PR (pin fully moved).
- **AC2** — CI quality run green on the PR head with 0.14.2 active (activate line shows 0.14.2 in logs; `check --all` + `analyze` exit 0).
- **AC3** — `crap4dart.yaml` unchanged OR migrated with `crap.threshold: 8.0` byte-identical.
- **AC4** — findings delta documented in the PR body: CRAP max/score before vs after (expect equal or the delta listed as follow-up issues).
- **AC5** — pre-commit hook version-synced (hook output or docs evidence).
- **AC6** — full standing gate sequence green: format → analyze → test → coverage ≥ 80% → crap4dart check --all → crap4dart analyze → agents suite (unchanged by this bump).

## Test plan
- **UT-1:** config parse: `crap4dart` reads repo `crap4dart.yaml` under 0.14.2 (exit 0, threshold echoed 8.0). (AC3)
- **IT-1:** CLI surface smoke on a fixture tree: `check --staged` on a staged clean change (exit 0) and on a staged CRAP-heavy fixture (exit 2) — proves the exit-code contract is preserved. (AC2)
- **IT-2:** coverage chain: `analyze --coverage=` consumes the lcov produced by the current quality.yml filter chain. (AC2, AC6)
- **E2E-1:** the PR's own CI run = the real gate on the real tree with 0.14.2. (AC2, AC6)
- **REG-1:** CRAP-score drift guard: max CRAP before vs after on main — equal or better, else the delta is enumerated (never silent). A red REG-1 blocks merge even when all other jobs are green. (AC4)
- **REG-2:** agents suite result identical baseline (751/751-class pass) — the bump must not touch the runtime. (AC6)

### Edge cases
- **E1** — 0.14.2 rejects `crap4dart.yaml`: migrate config in-PR, threshold byte-identical (I1); if migration impossible, fallback rule applies.
- **E2** — CRAP math changes flag EXISTING code > 8.0: file follow-ups, do not bump threshold (I4); gate stays red only if follow-ups are not acceptable to the owner — escalate, don't decide alone.
- **E3** — pub global activate fails on CI's dart SDK (SDK constraint): pin the tool's compatible dart SDK in the same PR, document in PR body.

## Non-goals
- No threshold/exclusion/gate-order changes. No CRAP refactors of flagged code (follow-ups). No switch to a different CRAP tool.

## Open questions
- None blocking; if 0.14.2 proves incompatible (E1/E3), the fallback question goes back to the owner with evidence.

## References
- AGENTS.md (pin-sync rule, gate sequence), GOAL.md Phase-0/2 (threshold law)
- Pin site: `.github/workflows/quality.yml:258`
- Upstream: https://pub.dev/packages/crap4dart (latest 0.14.2)

## Description

## Goal — crap4dart 0.14.2 (v1)
One sentence: **the quality-gate toolchain runs crap4dart 0.14.2 everywhere the gate executes — CI, pre-commit, local — with the same threshold and a strictly non-weakened gate set.**
Today every gate run activates crap4dart 0.9.5 (pinned in ONE place: `.github/workflows/quality.yml:258`). Upstream is 0.14.2 (pub.dev latest; 0.9.5→0.14.2 spans 0.12.x/0.13.x/0.14.x — config/CLI/output changes possible). The bump must land as ONE reviewable change with evidence that the gate got STRICTER-or-equal, never looser.

## Why this framing
- "Bump the version" alone is retracted: the SUBJECT of every step is the GATE CHAIN (CI activate + check + analyze + badge, pre-commit `check --staged`, local install), not the analyzed code.
- "Fix new findings first" is retracted: new-version CRAP math MAY flag new hotspots; those are follow-up parity work items (like agents CRAP issues #925-#930), NOT a reason to weaken the threshold or defer the bump.

## Architecture (named, with invariants)
- **Pin sites (exhaustive inventory, verify each):** CI `.github/workflows/quality.yml:258` (`dart pub global activate crap4dart 0.9.5`), the same file's `check --all` (l.259) / `analyze` (l.261) / badge step (l.293-296), the pre-commit hook (`crap4dart check --staged`), README/AGENTS.md mentions, any local bootstrap scripts.
- **Invariant I1:** threshold stays **8.0** (`crap4dart.yaml` — GOAL.md: "do not raise").
- **Invariant I2:** `sources: [lib, bin, test]` unchanged; coverage `required: true` unchanged.
- **Invariant I3:** local and CI versions are ALWAYS in sync (AGENTS.md rule) — one PR flips both or neither.
- **Invariant I4:** no gate is weakened, skipped, or `continue-on-error`'d to make 0.14.2 pass.
- **Fallback:** if 0.14.2 has a breaking regression (config unparseable, false-positive CRAP explosion from a tool bug — distinguish from REAL new findings), fall back to the newest version that passes cleanly and document the blocker as a separate issue; never pin an intermediate version silently.

## Capability surface (what the bump touches)
| Surface | Change | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| CI activate pin | 0.9.5 → 0.14.2 | single line |
| CLI surface | verify `check --staged`, `check --all`, `analyze --coverage=`, `init`, `install` still exist with same semantics | changelog diff 0.9.5→0.14.2 |
| Config schema | `crap4dart.yaml` parses under 0.14.2 unchanged | if schema moved: migrate config in the SAME PR, threshold preserved |
| Coverage chain | `dart test --coverage` → `format_coverage` → `crap4dart analyze --coverage=` still wire up | watch the lcov filter list (quality.yml ~l.159-172) |
| Badge | CRAP badge still computed/emitted | threshold text stays 8.0 |
| Pre-commit | hook runs 0.14.2 | sync = I3 |
| Findings delta | NEW findings from stricter math = listed, filed as follow-ups | NOT fixed in this PR unless trivial |

**Core:** version bump + full-chain verification + findings inventory. **Second tier:** follow-up CRAP fixes (separate items). **Excluded:** changing the threshold, exclusions, or gate order (rationale: the gate set is the product; the tool version is not).

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- **AC1** — `grep -rn "0\.9\.5" .github/ scripts/` returns zero crap4dart hits after the PR (pin fully moved).
- **AC2** — CI quality run green on the PR head with 0.14.2 active (activate line shows 0.14.2 in logs; `check --all` + `analyze` exit 0).
- **AC3** — `crap4dart.yaml` unchanged OR migrated with `crap.threshold: 8.0` byte-identical.
- **AC4** — findings delta documented in the PR body: CRAP max/score before vs after (expect equal or the delta listed as follow-up issues).
- **AC5** — pre-commit hook version-synced (hook output or docs evidence).
- **AC6** — full standing gate sequence green: format → analyze → test → coverage ≥ 80% → crap4dart check --all → crap4dart analyze → agents suite (unchanged by this bump).

## Test plan
- **UT-1:** config parse: `crap4dart` reads repo `crap4dart.yaml` under 0.14.2 (exit 0, threshold echoed 8.0). (AC3)
- **IT-1:** CLI surface smoke on a fixture tree: `check --staged` on a staged clean change (exit 0) and on a staged CRAP-heavy fixture (exit 2) — proves the exit-code contract is preserved. (AC2)
- **IT-2:** coverage chain: `analyze --coverage=` consumes the lcov produced by the current quality.yml filter chain. (AC2, AC6)
- **E2E-1:** the PR's own CI run = the real gate on the real tree with 0.14.2. (AC2, AC6)
- **REG-1:** CRAP-score drift guard: max CRAP before vs after on main — equal or better, else the delta is enumerated (never silent). A red REG-1 blocks merge even when all other jobs are green. (AC4)
- **REG-2:** agents suite result identical baseline (751/751-class pass) — the bump must not touch the runtime. (AC6)

### Edge cases
- **E1** — 0.14.2 rejects `crap4dart.yaml`: migrate config in-PR, threshold byte-identical (I1); if migration impossible, fallback rule applies.
- **E2** — CRAP math changes flag EXISTING code > 8.0: file follow-ups, do not bump threshold (I4); gate stays red only if follow-ups are not acceptable to the owner — escalate, don't decide alone.
- **E3** — pub global activate fails on CI's dart SDK (SDK constraint): pin the tool's compatible dart SDK in the same PR, document in PR body.

## Non-goals
- No threshold/exclusion/gate-order changes. No CRAP refactors of flagged code (follow-ups). No switch to a different CRAP tool.

## Open questions
- None blocking; if 0.14.2 proves incompatible (E1/E3), the fallback question goes back to the owner with evidence.

## References
- AGENTS.md (pin-sync rule, gate sequence), GOAL.md Phase-0/2 (threshold law)
- Pin site: `.github/workflows/quality.yml:258`
- Upstream: https://pub.dev/packages/crap4dart (latest 0.14.2)

# gh-425: Upgrade crap4dart 0.9.5 -> 0.14.2 (quality-gate toolchain bump, zero gate weakening)

## Description

## Goal — crap4dart 0.14.2 (v1)
One sentence: **the quality-gate toolchain runs crap4dart 0.14.2 everywhere the gate executes — CI, pre-commit, local — with the same threshold and a strictly non-weakened gate set.**
Today every gate run activates crap4dart 0.9.5 (pinned in ONE place: `.github/workflows/quality.yml:258`). Upstream is 0.14.2 (pub.dev latest; 0.9.5→0.14.2 spans 0.12.x/0.13.x/0.14.x — config/CLI/output changes possible). The bump must land as ONE reviewable change with evidence that the gate got STRICTER-or-equal, never looser.

## Why this framing
- "Bump the version" alone is retracted: the SUBJECT of every step is the GATE CHAIN (CI activate + check + analyze + badge, pre-commit `check --staged`, local install), not the analyzed code.
- "Fix new findings first" is retracted: new-version CRAP math MAY flag new hotspots; those are follow-up parity work items (like agents CRAP issues #925-#930), NOT a reason to weaken the threshold or defer the bump.

## Architecture (named, with invariants)
- **Pin sites (exhaustive inventory, verify each):** CI `.github/workflows/quality.yml:258` (`dart pub global activate crap4dart 0.9.5`), the same file's `check --all` (l.259) / `analyze` (l.261) / badge step (l.293-296), the pre-commit hook (`crap4dart check --staged`), README/AGENTS.md mentions, any local bootstrap scripts.
- **Invariant I1:** threshold stays **8.0** (`crap4dart.yaml` — GOAL.md: "do not raise").
- **Invariant I2:** `sources: [lib, bin, test]` unchanged; coverage `required: true` unchanged.
- **Invariant I3:** local and CI versions are ALWAYS in sync (AGENTS.md rule) — one PR flips both or neither.
- **Invariant I4:** no gate is weakened, skipped, or `continue-on-error`'d to make 0.14.2 pass.
- **Fallback:** if 0.14.2 has a breaking regression (config unparseable, false-positive CRAP explosion from a tool bug — distinguish from REAL new findings), fall back to the newest version that passes cleanly and document the blocker as a separate issue; never pin an intermediate version silently.

## Capability surface (what the bump touches)
| Surface | Change | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| CI activate pin | 0.9.5 → 0.14.2 | single line |
| CLI surface | verify `check --staged`, `check --all`, `analyze --coverage=`, `init`, `install` still exist with same semantics | changelog diff 0.9.5→0.14.2 |
| Config schema | `crap4dart.yaml` parses under 0.14.2 unchanged | if schema moved: migrate config in the SAME PR, threshold preserved |
| Coverage chain | `dart test --coverage` → `format_coverage` → `crap4dart analyze --coverage=` still wire up | watch the lcov filter list (quality.yml ~l.159-172) |
| Badge | CRAP badge still computed/emitted | threshold text stays 8.0 |
| Pre-commit | hook runs 0.14.2 | sync = I3 |
| Findings delta | NEW findings from stricter math = listed, filed as follow-ups | NOT fixed in this PR unless trivial |

**Core:** version bump + full-chain verification + findings inventory. **Second tier:** follow-up CRAP fixes (separate items). **Excluded:** changing the threshold, exclusions, or gate order (rationale: the gate set is the product; the tool version is not).

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- **AC1** — `grep -rn "0\.9\.5" .github/ scripts/` returns zero crap4dart hits after the PR (pin fully moved).
- **AC2** — CI quality run green on the PR head with 0.14.2 active (activate line shows 0.14.2 in logs; `check --all` + `analyze` exit 0).
- **AC3** — `crap4dart.yaml` unchanged OR migrated with `crap.threshold: 8.0` byte-identical.
- **AC4** — findings delta documented in the PR body: CRAP max/score before vs after (expect equal or the delta listed as follow-up issues).
- **AC5** — pre-commit hook version-synced (hook output or docs evidence).
- **AC6** — full standing gate sequence green: format → analyze → test → coverage ≥ 80% → crap4dart check --all → crap4dart analyze → agents suite (unchanged by this bump).

## Test plan
- **UT-1:** config parse: `crap4dart` reads repo `crap4dart.yaml` under 0.14.2 (exit 0, threshold echoed 8.0). (AC3)
- **IT-1:** CLI surface smoke on a fixture tree: `check --staged` on a staged clean change (exit 0) and on a staged CRAP-heavy fixture (exit 2) — proves the exit-code contract is preserved. (AC2)
- **IT-2:** coverage chain: `analyze --coverage=` consumes the lcov produced by the current quality.yml filter chain. (AC2, AC6)
- **E2E-1:** the PR's own CI run = the real gate on the real tree with 0.14.2. (AC2, AC6)
- **REG-1:** CRAP-score drift guard: max CRAP before vs after on main — equal or better, else the delta is enumerated (never silent). A red REG-1 blocks merge even when all other jobs are green. (AC4)
- **REG-2:** agents suite result identical baseline (751/751-class pass) — the bump must not touch the runtime. (AC6)

### Edge cases
- **E1** — 0.14.2 rejects `crap4dart.yaml`: migrate config in-PR, threshold byte-identical (I1); if migration impossible, fallback rule applies.
- **E2** — CRAP math changes flag EXISTING code > 8.0: file follow-ups, do not bump threshold (I4); gate stays red only if follow-ups are not acceptable to the owner — escalate, don't decide alone.
- **E3** — pub global activate fails on CI's dart SDK (SDK constraint): pin the tool's compatible dart SDK in the same PR, document in PR body.

## Non-goals
- No threshold/exclusion/gate-order changes. No CRAP refactors of flagged code (follow-ups). No switch to a different CRAP tool.

## Open questions
- None blocking; if 0.14.2 proves incompatible (E1/E3), the fallback question goes back to the owner with evidence.

## References
- AGENTS.md (pin-sync rule, gate sequence), GOAL.md Phase-0/2 (threshold law)
- Pin site: `.github/workflows/quality.yml:258`
- Upstream: https://pub.dev/packages/crap4dart (latest 0.14.2)

# gh-425: Upgrade crap4dart 0.9.5 -> 0.14.2 (quality-gate toolchain bump, zero gate weakening)

## Description

## Goal — crap4dart 0.14.2 (v1)
One sentence: **the quality-gate toolchain runs crap4dart 0.14.2 everywhere the gate executes — CI, pre-commit, local — with the same threshold and a strictly non-weakened gate set.**
Today every gate run activates crap4dart 0.9.5 (pinned in ONE place: `.github/workflows/quality.yml:258`). Upstream is 0.14.2 (pub.dev latest; 0.9.5→0.14.2 spans 0.12.x/0.13.x/0.14.x — config/CLI/output changes possible). The bump must land as ONE reviewable change with evidence that the gate got STRICTER-or-equal, never looser.

## Why this framing
- "Bump the version" alone is retracted: the SUBJECT of every step is the GATE CHAIN (CI activate + check + analyze + badge, pre-commit `check --staged`, local install), not the analyzed code.

# gh-425: Upgrade crap4dart 0.9.5 -> 0.14.2 (quality-gate toolchain bump, zero gate weakening)

## Description

## Goal — crap4dart 0.14.2 (v1)
One sentence: **the quality-gate toolchain runs crap4dart 0.14.2 everywhere the gate executes — CI, pre-commit, local — with the same threshold and a strictly non-weakened gate set.**
Today every gate run activates crap4dart 0.9.5 (pinned in ONE place: `.github/workflows/quality.yml:258`). Upstream is 0.14.2 (pub.dev latest; 0.9.5→0.14.2 spans 0.12.x/0.13.x/0.14.x — config/CLI/output changes possible). The bump must land as ONE reviewable change with evidence that the gate got STRICTER-or-equal, never looser.

## Why this framing
- "Bump the version" alone is retracted: the SUBJECT of every step is the GATE CHAIN (CI activate + check + analyze + badge, pre-commit `check --staged`, local install), not the analyzed code.
- "Fix new findings first" is retracted: new-version CRAP math MAY flag new hotspots; those are follow-up parity work items (like agents CRAP issues #925-#930), NOT a reason to weaken the threshold or defer the bump.

## Architecture (named, with invariants)
- **Pin sites (exhaustive inventory, verify each):** CI `.github/workflows/quality.yml:258` (`dart pub global activate crap4dart 0.9.5`), the same file's `check --all` (l.259) / `analyze` (l.261) / badge step (l.293-296), the pre-commit hook (`crap4dart check --staged`), README/AGENTS.md mentions, any local bootstrap scripts.
- **Invariant I1:** threshold stays **8.0** (`crap4dart.yaml` — GOAL.md: "do not raise").
- **Invariant I2:** `sources: [lib, bin, test]` unchanged; coverage `required: true` unchanged.
- **Invariant I3:** local and CI versions are ALWAYS in sync (AGENTS.md rule) — one PR flips both or neither.
- **Invariant I4:** no gate is weakened, skipped, or `continue-on-error`'d to make 0.14.2 pass.
- **Fallback:** if 0.14.2 has a breaking regression (config unparseable, false-positive CRAP explosion from a tool bug — distinguish from REAL new findings), fall back to the newest version that passes cleanly and document the blocker as a separate issue; never pin an intermediate version silently.

## Capability surface (what the bump touches)
| Surface | Change | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| CI activate pin | 0.9.5 → 0.14.2 | single line |
| CLI surface | verify `check --staged`, `check --all`, `analyze --coverage=`, `init`, `install` still exist with same semantics | changelog diff 0.9.5→0.14.2 |
| Config schema | `crap4dart.yaml` parses under 0.14.2 unchanged | if schema moved: migrate config in the SAME PR, threshold preserved |
| Coverage chain | `dart test --coverage` → `format_coverage` → `crap4dart analyze --coverage=` still wire up | watch the lcov filter list (quality.yml ~l.159-172) |
| Badge | CRAP badge still computed/emitted | threshold text stays 8.0 |
| Pre-commit | hook runs 0.14.2 | sync = I3 |
| Findings delta | NEW findings from stricter math = listed, filed as follow-ups | NOT fixed in this PR unless trivial |

**Core:** version bump + full-chain verification + findings inventory. **Second tier:** follow-up CRAP fixes (separate items). **Excluded:** changing the threshold, exclusions, or gate order (rationale: the gate set is the product; the tool version is not).

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- **AC1** — `grep -rn "0\.9\.5" .github/ scripts/` returns zero crap4dart hits after the PR (pin fully moved).
- **AC2** — CI quality run green on the PR head with 0.14.2 active (activate line shows 0.14.2 in logs; `check --all` + `analyze` exit 0).
- **AC3** — `crap4dart.yaml` unchanged OR migrated with `crap.threshold: 8.0` byte-identical.
- **AC4** — findings delta documented in the PR body: CRAP max/score before vs after (expect equal or the delta listed as follow-up issues).
- **AC5** — pre-commit hook version-synced (hook output or docs evidence).
- **AC6** — full standing gate sequence green: format → analyze → test → coverage ≥ 80% → crap4dart check --all → crap4dart analyze → agents suite (unchanged by this bump).

## Test plan
- **UT-1:** config parse: `crap4dart` reads repo `crap4dart.yaml` under 0.14.2 (exit 0, threshold echoed 8.0). (AC3)
- **IT-1:** CLI surface smoke on a fixture tree: `check --staged` on a staged clean change (exit 0) and on a staged CRAP-heavy fixture (exit 2) — proves the exit-code contract is preserved. (AC2)
- **IT-2:** coverage chain: `analyze --coverage=` consumes the lcov produced by the current quality.yml filter chain. (AC2, AC6)
- **E2E-1:** the PR's own CI run = the real gate on the real tree with 0.14.2. (AC2, AC6)
- **REG-1:** CRAP-score drift guard: max CRAP before vs after on main — equal or better, else the delta is enumerated (never silent). A red REG-1 blocks merge even when all other jobs are green. (AC4)
- **REG-2:** agents suite result identical baseline (751/751-class pass) — the bump must not touch the runtime. (AC6)

## Goal — crap4dart 0.14.2 (v1)

## Why this framing
- "Bump the version" alone is retracted: the SUBJECT of every step is the GATE CHAIN (CI activate + check + analyze + badge, pre-commit `check --staged`, local install), not the analyzed code.
- "Fix new findings first" is retracted: new-version CRAP math MAY flag new hotspots; those are follow-up parity work items (like agents CRAP issues #925-#930), NOT a reason to weaken the threshold or defer the bump.

## Architecture (named, with invariants)
- **Pin sites (exhaustive inventory, verify each):** CI `.github/workflows/quality.yml:258` (`dart pub global activate crap4dart 0.9.5`), the same file's `check --all` (l.259) / `analyze` (l.261) / badge step (l.293-296), the pre-commit hook (`crap4dart check --staged`), README/AGENTS.md mentions, any local bootstrap scripts.
- **Invariant I1:** threshold stays **8.0** (`crap4dart.yaml` — GOAL.md: "do not raise").
- **Invariant I2:** `sources: [lib, bin, test]` unchanged; coverage `required: true` unchanged.
- **Invariant I3:** local and CI versions are ALWAYS in sync (AGENTS.md rule) — one PR flips both or neither.
- **Invariant I4:** no gate is weakened, skipped, or `continue-on-error`'d to make 0.14.2 pass.
- **Fallback:** if 0.14.2 has a breaking regression (config unparseable, false-positive CRAP explosion from a tool bug — distinguish from REAL new findings), fall back to the newest version that passes cleanly and document the blocker as a separate issue; never pin an intermediate version silently.

## Capability surface (what the bump touches)
| Surface | Change | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| CI activate pin | 0.9.5 → 0.14.2 | single line |
| CLI surface | verify `check --staged`, `check --all`, `analyze --coverage=`, `init`, `install` still exist with same semantics | changelog diff 0.9.5→0.14.2 |

| Badge | CRAP badge still computed/emitted | threshold text stays 8.0 |
| Pre-commit | hook runs 0.14.2 | sync = I3 |
| Findings delta | NEW findings from stricter math = listed, filed as follow-ups | NOT fixed in this PR unless trivial |

# gh-425: Upgrade crap4dart 0.9.5 -> 0.14.2 (quality-gate toolchain bump, zero gate weakening)

## Description

## Goal — crap4dart 0.14.2 (v1)
One sentence: **the quality-gate toolchain runs crap4dart 0.14.2 everywhere the gate executes — CI, pre-commit, local — with the same threshold and a strictly non-weakened gate set.**
Today every gate run activates crap4dart 0.9.5 (pinned in ONE place: `.github/workflows/quality.yml:258`). Upstream is 0.14.2 (pub.dev latest; 0.9.5→0.14.2 spans 0.12.x/0.13.x/0.14.x — config/CLI/output changes possible). The bump must land as ONE reviewable change with evidence that the gate got STRICTER-or-equal, never looser.

## Why this framing
- "Bump the version" alone is retracted: the SUBJECT of every step is the GATE CHAIN (CI activate + check + analyze + badge, pre-commit `check --staged`, local install), not the analyzed code.
- "Fix new findings first" is retracted: new-version CRAP math MAY flag new hotspots; those are follow-up parity work items (like agents CRAP issues #925-#930), NOT a reason to weaken the threshold or defer the bump.

## Architecture (named, with invariants)
- **Pin sites (exhaustive inventory, verify each):** CI `.github/workflows/quality.yml:258` (`dart pub global activate crap4dart 0.9.5`), the same file's `check --all` (l.259) / `analyze` (l.261) / badge step (l.293-296), the pre-commit hook (`crap4dart check --staged`), README/AGENTS.md mentions, any local bootstrap scripts.
- **Invariant I1:** threshold stays **8.0** (`crap4dart.yaml` — GOAL.md: "do not raise").
- **Invariant I2:** `sources: [lib, bin, test]` unchanged; coverage `required: true` unchanged.
- **Invariant I3:** local and CI versions are ALWAYS in sync (AGENTS.md rule) — one PR flips both or neither.
- **Invariant I4:** no gate is weakened, skipped, or `continue-on-error`'d to make 0.14.2 pass.
- **Fallback:** if 0.14.2 has a breaking regression (config unparseable, false-positive CRAP explosion from a tool bug — distinguish from REAL new findings), fall back to the newest version that passes cleanly and document the blocker as a separate issue; never pin an intermediate version silently.

## Capability surface (what the bump touches)
| Surface | Change | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| CI activate pin | 0.9.5 → 0.14.2 | single line |
| CLI surface | verify `check --staged`, `check --all`, `analyze --coverage=`, `init`, `install` still exist with same semantics | changelog diff 0.9.5→0.14.2 |
| Config schema | `crap4dart.yaml` parses under 0.14.2 unchanged | if schema moved: migrate config in the SAME PR, threshold preserved |
| Coverage chain | `dart test --coverage` → `format_coverage` → `crap4dart analyze --coverage=` still wire up | watch the lcov filter list (quality.yml ~l.159-172) |
| Badge | CRAP badge still computed/emitted | threshold text stays 8.0 |
| Pre-commit | hook runs 0.14.2 | sync = I3 |
| Findings delta | NEW findings from stricter math = listed, filed as follow-ups | NOT fixed in this PR unless trivial |

**Core:** version bump + full-chain verification + findings inventory. **Second tier:** follow-up CRAP fixes (separate items). **Excluded:** changing the threshold, exclusions, or gate order (rationale: the gate set is the product; the tool version is not).

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- **AC1** — `grep -rn "0\.9\.5" .github/ scripts/` returns zero crap4dart hits after the PR (pin fully moved).
- **AC2** — CI quality run green on the PR head with 0.14.2 active (activate line shows 0.14.2 in logs; `check --all` + `analyze` exit 0).
- **AC3** — `crap4dart.yaml` unchanged OR migrated with `crap.threshold: 8.0` byte-identical.
- **AC4** — findings delta documented in the PR body: CRAP max/score before vs after (expect equal or the delta listed as follow-up issues).
- **AC5** — pre-commit hook version-synced (hook output or docs evidence).
- **AC6** — full standing gate sequence green: format → analyze → test → coverage ≥ 80% → crap4dart check --all → crap4dart analyze → agents suite (unchanged by this bump).

## Test plan
- **UT-1:** config parse: `crap4dart` reads repo `crap4dart.yaml` under 0.14.2 (exit 0, threshold echoed 8.0). (AC3)
- **IT-1:** CLI surface smoke on a fixture tree: `check --staged` on a staged clean change (exit 0) and on a staged CRAP-heavy fixture (exit 2) — proves the exit-code contract is preserved. (AC2)
- **IT-2:** coverage chain: `analyze --coverage=` consumes the lcov produced by the current quality.yml filter chain. (AC2, AC6)
- **E2E-1:** the PR's own CI run = the real gate on the real tree with 0.14.2. (AC2, AC6)
- **REG-1:** CRAP-score drift guard: max CRAP before vs after on main — equal or better, else the delta is enumerated (never silent). A red REG-1 blocks merge even when all other jobs are green. (AC4)
- **REG-2:** agents suite result identical baseline (751/751-class pass) — the bump must not touch the runtime. (AC6)

## Why this framing
- "Bump the version" alone is retracted: the SUBJECT of every step is the GATE CHAIN (CI activate + check + analyze + badge, pre-commit `check --staged`, local install), not the analyzed code.
- "Fix new findings first" is retracted: new-version CRAP math MAY flag new hotspots; those are follow-up parity work items (like agents CRAP issues #925-#930), NOT a reason to weaken the threshold or defer the bump.

## Architecture (named, with invariants)

- **Invariant I2:** `sources: [lib, bin, test]` unchanged; coverage `required: true` unchanged.
- **Invariant I3:** local and CI versions are ALWAYS in sync (AGENTS.md rule) — one PR flips both or neither.
- **Invariant I4:** no gate is weakened, skipped, or `continue-on-error`'d to make 0.14.2 pass.

| Surface | Change | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| CI activate pin | 0.9.5 → 0.14.2 | single line |

| Badge | CRAP badge still computed/emitted | threshold text stays 8.0 |
| Pre-commit | hook runs 0.14.2 | sync = I3 |
| Findings delta | NEW findings from stricter math = listed, filed as follow-ups | NOT fixed in this PR unless trivial |

# gh-425: Upgrade crap4dart 0.9.5 -> 0.14.2 (quality-gate toolchain bump, zero gate weakening)

## Description

## Goal — crap4dart 0.14.2 (v1)
One sentence: **the quality-gate toolchain runs crap4dart 0.14.2 everywhere the gate executes — CI, pre-commit, local — with the same threshold and a strictly non-weakened gate set.**
Today every gate run activates crap4dart 0.9.5 (pinned in ONE place: `.github/workflows/quality.yml:258`). Upstream is 0.14.2 (pub.dev latest; 0.9.5→0.14.2 spans 0.12.x/0.13.x/0.14.x — config/CLI/output changes possible). The bump must land as ONE reviewable change with evidence that the gate got STRICTER-or-equal, never looser.

## Why this framing
- "Bump the version" alone is retracted: the SUBJECT of every step is the GATE CHAIN (CI activate + check + analyze + badge, pre-commit `check --staged`, local install), not the analyzed code.
- "Fix new findings first" is retracted: new-version CRAP math MAY flag new hotspots; those are follow-up parity work items (like agents CRAP issues #925-#930), NOT a reason to weaken the threshold or defer the bump.

## Architecture (named, with invariants)
- **Pin sites (exhaustive inventory, verify each):** CI `.github/workflows/quality.yml:258` (`dart pub global activate crap4dart 0.9.5`), the same file's `check --all` (l.259) / `analyze` (l.261) / badge step (l.293-296), the pre-commit hook (`crap4dart check --staged`), README/AGENTS.md mentions, any local bootstrap scripts.
- **Invariant I1:** threshold stays **8.0** (`crap4dart.yaml` — GOAL.md: "do not raise").
- **Invariant I2:** `sources: [lib, bin, test]` unchanged; coverage `required: true` unchanged.
- **Invariant I3:** local and CI versions are ALWAYS in sync (AGENTS.md rule) — one PR flips both or neither.
- **Invariant I4:** no gate is weakened, skipped, or `continue-on-error`'d to make 0.14.2 pass.
- **Fallback:** if 0.14.2 has a breaking regression (config unparseable, false-positive CRAP explosion from a tool bug — distinguish from REAL new findings), fall back to the newest version that passes cleanly and document the blocker as a separate issue; never pin an intermediate version silently.

## Capability surface (what the bump touches)
| Surface | Change | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| CI activate pin | 0.9.5 → 0.14.2 | single line |
| CLI surface | verify `check --staged`, `check --all`, `analyze --coverage=`, `init`, `install` still exist with same semantics | changelog diff 0.9.5→0.14.2 |
| Config schema | `crap4dart.yaml` parses under 0.14.2 unchanged | if schema moved: migrate config in the SAME PR, threshold preserved |
| Coverage chain | `dart test --coverage` → `format_coverage` → `crap4dart analyze --coverage=` still wire up | watch the lcov filter list (quality.yml ~l.159-172) |
| Badge | CRAP badge still computed/emitted | threshold text stays 8.0 |
| Pre-commit | hook runs 0.14.2 | sync = I3 |
| Findings delta | NEW findings from stricter math = listed, filed as follow-ups | NOT fixed in this PR unless trivial |

**Core:** version bump + full-chain verification + findings inventory. **Second tier:** follow-up CRAP fixes (separate items). **Excluded:** changing the threshold, exclusions, or gate order (rationale: the gate set is the product; the tool version is not).

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- **AC1** — `grep -rn "0\.9\.5" .github/ scripts/` returns zero crap4dart hits after the PR (pin fully moved).
- **AC2** — CI quality run green on the PR head with 0.14.2 active (activate line shows 0.14.2 in logs; `check --all` + `analyze` exit 0).
- **AC3** — `crap4dart.yaml` unchanged OR migrated with `crap.threshold: 8.0` byte-identical.
- **AC4** — findings delta documented in the PR body: CRAP max/score before vs after (expect equal or the delta listed as follow-up issues).
- **AC5** — pre-commit hook version-synced (hook output or docs evidence).
- **AC6** — full standing gate sequence green: format → analyze → test → coverage ≥ 80% → crap4dart check --all → crap4dart analyze → agents suite (unchanged by this bump).

## Test plan
- **UT-1:** config parse: `crap4dart` reads repo `crap4dart.yaml` under 0.14.2 (exit 0, threshold echoed 8.0). (AC3)
- **IT-1:** CLI surface smoke on a fixture tree: `check --staged` on a staged clean change (exit 0) and on a staged CRAP-heavy fixture (exit 2) — proves the exit-code contract is preserved. (AC2)
- **IT-2:** coverage chain: `analyze --coverage=` consumes the lcov produced by the current quality.yml filter chain. (AC2, AC6)
- **E2E-1:** the PR's own CI run = the real gate on the real tree with 0.14.2. (AC2, AC6)
- **REG-1:** CRAP-score drift guard: max CRAP before vs after on main — equal or better, else the delta is enumerated (never silent). A red REG-1 blocks merge even when all other jobs are green. (AC4)
- **REG-2:** agents suite result identical baseline (751/751-class pass) — the bump must not touch the runtime. (AC6)

### Edge cases
- **E1** — 0.14.2 rejects `crap4dart.yaml`: migrate config in-PR, threshold byte-identical (I1); if migration impossible, fallback rule applies.
- **E2** — CRAP math changes flag EXISTING code > 8.0: file follow-ups, do not bump threshold (I4); gate stays red only if follow-ups are not acceptable to the owner — escalate, don't decide alone.
- **E3** — pub global activate fails on CI's dart SDK (SDK constraint): pin the tool's compatible dart SDK in the same PR, document in PR body.

## Non-goals
- No threshold/exclusion/gate-order changes. No CRAP refactors of flagged code (follow-ups). No switch to a different CRAP tool.

## Open questions
- None blocking; if 0.14.2 proves incompatible (E1/E3), the fallback question goes back to the owner with evidence.

## References
- AGENTS.md (pin-sync rule, gate sequence), GOAL.md Phase-0/2 (threshold law)
- Pin site: `.github/workflows/quality.yml:258`
- Upstream: https://pub.dev/packages/crap4dart (latest 0.14.2)

## Description

## Goal — crap4dart 0.14.2 (v1)
One sentence: **the quality-gate toolchain runs crap4dart 0.14.2 everywhere the gate executes — CI, pre-commit, local — with the same threshold and a strictly non-weakened gate set.**
Today every gate run activates crap4dart 0.9.5 (pinned in ONE place: `.github/workflows/quality.yml:258`). Upstream is 0.14.2 (pub.dev latest; 0.9.5→0.14.2 spans 0.12.x/0.13.x/0.14.x — config/CLI/output changes possible). The bump must land as ONE reviewable change with evidence that the gate got STRICTER-or-equal, never looser.

## Why this framing
- "Bump the version" alone is retracted: the SUBJECT of every step is the GATE CHAIN (CI activate + check + analyze + badge, pre-commit `check --staged`, local install), not the analyzed code.
- "Fix new findings first" is retracted: new-version CRAP math MAY flag new hotspots; those are follow-up parity work items (like agents CRAP issues #925-#930), NOT a reason to weaken the threshold or defer the bump.

## Architecture (named, with invariants)
- **Pin sites (exhaustive inventory, verify each):** CI `.github/workflows/quality.yml:258` (`dart pub global activate crap4dart 0.9.5`), the same file's `check --all` (l.259) / `analyze` (l.261) / badge step (l.293-296), the pre-commit hook (`crap4dart check --staged`), README/AGENTS.md mentions, any local bootstrap scripts.
- **Invariant I1:** threshold stays **8.0** (`crap4dart.yaml` — GOAL.md: "do not raise").
- **Invariant I2:** `sources: [lib, bin, test]` unchanged; coverage `required: true` unchanged.
- **Invariant I3:** local and CI versions are ALWAYS in sync (AGENTS.md rule) — one PR flips both or neither.
- **Invariant I4:** no gate is weakened, skipped, or `continue-on-error`'d to make 0.14.2 pass.
- **Fallback:** if 0.14.2 has a breaking regression (config unparseable, false-positive CRAP explosion from a tool bug — distinguish from REAL new findings), fall back to the newest version that passes cleanly and document the blocker as a separate issue; never pin an intermediate version silently.

## Capability surface (what the bump touches)
| Surface | Change | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| CI activate pin | 0.9.5 → 0.14.2 | single line |
| CLI surface | verify `check --staged`, `check --all`, `analyze --coverage=`, `init`, `install` still exist with same semantics | changelog diff 0.9.5→0.14.2 |
| Config schema | `crap4dart.yaml` parses under 0.14.2 unchanged | if schema moved: migrate config in the SAME PR, threshold preserved |
| Coverage chain | `dart test --coverage` → `format_coverage` → `crap4dart analyze --coverage=` still wire up | watch the lcov filter list (quality.yml ~l.159-172) |
| Badge | CRAP badge still computed/emitted | threshold text stays 8.0 |
| Pre-commit | hook runs 0.14.2 | sync = I3 |
| Findings delta | NEW findings from stricter math = listed, filed as follow-ups | NOT fixed in this PR unless trivial |

**Core:** version bump + full-chain verification + findings inventory. **Second tier:** follow-up CRAP fixes (separate items). **Excluded:** changing the threshold, exclusions, or gate order (rationale: the gate set is the product; the tool version is not).

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- **AC1** — `grep -rn "0\.9\.5" .github/ scripts/` returns zero crap4dart hits after the PR (pin fully moved).
- **AC2** — CI quality run green on the PR head with 0.14.2 active (activate line shows 0.14.2 in logs; `check --all` + `analyze` exit 0).
- **AC3** — `crap4dart.yaml` unchanged OR migrated with `crap.threshold: 8.0` byte-identical.
- **AC4** — findings delta documented in the PR body: CRAP max/score before vs after (expect equal or the delta listed as follow-up issues).
- **AC5** — pre-commit hook version-synced (hook output or docs evidence).
- **AC6** — full standing gate sequence green: format → analyze → test → coverage ≥ 80% → crap4dart check --all → crap4dart analyze → agents suite (unchanged by this bump).

## Test plan
- **UT-1:** config parse: `crap4dart` reads repo `crap4dart.yaml` under 0.14.2 (exit 0, threshold echoed 8.0). (AC3)
- **IT-1:** CLI surface smoke on a fixture tree: `check --staged` on a staged clean change (exit 0) and on a staged CRAP-heavy fixture (exit 2) — proves the exit-code contract is preserved. (AC2)
- **IT-2:** coverage chain: `analyze --coverage=` consumes the lcov produced by the current quality.yml filter chain. (AC2, AC6)
- **E2E-1:** the PR's own CI run = the real gate on the real tree with 0.14.2. (AC2, AC6)
- **REG-1:** CRAP-score drift guard: max CRAP before vs after on main — equal or better, else the delta is enumerated (never silent). A red REG-1 blocks merge even when all other jobs are green. (AC4)
- **REG-2:** agents suite result identical baseline (751/751-class pass) — the bump must not touch the runtime. (AC6)

### Edge cases
- **E1** — 0.14.2 rejects `crap4dart.yaml`: migrate config in-PR, threshold byte-identical (I1); if migration impossible, fallback rule applies.
- **E2** — CRAP math changes flag EXISTING code > 8.0: file follow-ups, do not bump threshold (I4); gate stays red only if follow-ups are not acceptable to the owner — escalate, don't decide alone.
- **E3** — pub global activate fails on CI's dart SDK (SDK constraint): pin the tool's compatible dart SDK in the same PR, document in PR body.

## Non-goals
- No threshold/exclusion/gate-order changes. No CRAP refactors of flagged code (follow-ups). No switch to a different CRAP tool.

## Open questions
- None blocking; if 0.14.2 proves incompatible (E1/E3), the fallback question goes back to the owner with evidence.

## References
- AGENTS.md (pin-sync rule, gate sequence), GOAL.md Phase-0/2 (threshold law)
- Pin site: `.github/workflows/quality.yml:258`
- Upstream: https://pub.dev/packages/crap4dart (latest 0.14.2)

# gh-425: Upgrade crap4dart 0.9.5 -> 0.14.2 (quality-gate toolchain bump, zero gate weakening)

## Description

## Goal — crap4dart 0.14.2 (v1)
One sentence: **the quality-gate toolchain runs crap4dart 0.14.2 everywhere the gate executes — CI, pre-commit, local — with the same threshold and a strictly non-weakened gate set.**
Today every gate run activates crap4dart 0.9.5 (pinned in ONE place: `.github/workflows/quality.yml:258`). Upstream is 0.14.2 (pub.dev latest; 0.9.5→0.14.2 spans 0.12.x/0.13.x/0.14.x — config/CLI/output changes possible).               :

## Goal — crap4dart 0.14.2 (v1)
One sentence: **the quality-gate toolchain runs crap4dart 0.14.2 everywhere the gate executes — CI, pre-commit, local — with the same threshold and a strictly non-weakened gate set.**
Today every gate run activates crap4dart 0.9.5 (pinned in ONE place: `.github/workflows/quality.yml:258`). Upstream is 0.14.2 (pub.dev latest; 0.9.5→0.14.2 spans 0.12.x/0.13.x/0.14.x — config/CLI/output changes possible). The bump must land as ONE reviewable change with evidence that the gate got STRICTER-or-equal, never looser.

## Why this framing
- "Bump the version" alone is retracted: the SUBJECT of every step is the GATE CHAIN (CI activate + check + analyze + badge, pre-commit `check --staged`, local install), not the analyzed code.
- "Fix new findings first" is retracted: new-version CRAP math MAY flag new hotspots; those are follow-up parity work items (like agents CRAP issues #925-#930), NOT a reason to weaken the threshold or defer the bump.

## Architecture (named, with invariants)
- **Pin sites (exhaustive inventory, verify each):** CI `.github/workflows/quality.yml:258` (`dart pub global activate crap4dart 0.9.5`), the same file's `check --all` (l.259) / `analyze` (l.261) / badge step (l.293-296), the pre-commit hook (`crap4dart check --staged`), README/AGENTS.md mentions, any local bootstrap scripts.
- **Invariant I1:** threshold stays **8.0** (`crap4dart.yaml` — GOAL.md: "do not raise").
- **Invariant I2:** `sources: [lib, bin, test]` unchanged; coverage `required: true` unchanged.
- **Invariant I3:** local and CI versions are ALWAYS in sync (AGENTS.md rule) — one PR flips both or neither.
- **Invariant I4:** no gate is weakened, skipped, or `continue-on-error`'d to make 0.14.2 pass.
- **Fallback:** if 0.14.2 has a breaking regression (config unparseable, false-positive CRAP explosion from a tool bug — distinguish from REAL new findings), fall back to the newest version that passes cleanly and document the blocker as a separate issue; never pin an intermediate version silently.

## Capability surface (what the bump touches)
| Surface | Change | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| CI activate pin | 0.9.5 → 0.14.2 | single line |
| CLI surface | verify `check --staged`, `check --all`, `analyze --coverage=`, `init`, `install` still exist with same semantics | changelog diff 0.9.5→0.14.2 |
| Config schema | `crap4dart.yaml` parses under 0.14.2 unchanged | if schema moved: migrate config in the SAME PR, threshold preserved |
| Coverage chain | `dart test --coverage` → `format_coverage` → `crap4dart analyze --coverage=` still wire up | watch the lcov filter list (quality.yml ~l.159-172) |
| Badge | CRAP badge still computed/emitted | threshold text stays 8.0 |
| Pre-commit | hook runs 0.14.2 | sync = I3 |
| Findings delta | NEW findings from stricter math = listed, filed as follow-ups | NOT fixed in this PR unless trivial |

**Core:** version bump + full-chain verification + findings inventory. **Second tier:** follow-up CRAP fixes (separate items). **Excluded:** changing the threshold, exclusions, or gate order (rationale: the gate set is the product; the tool version is not).

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- **AC1** — `grep -rn "0\.9\.5" .github/ scripts/` returns zero crap4dart hits after the PR (pin fully moved).
- **AC2** — CI quality run green on the PR head with 0.14.2 active (activate line shows 0.14.2 in logs; `check --all` + `analyze` exit 0).
- **AC3** — `crap4dart.yaml` unchanged OR migrated with `crap.threshold: 8.0` byte-identical.
- **AC4** — findings delta documented in the PR body: CRAP max/score before vs after (expect equal or the delta listed as follow-up issues).
- **AC5** — pre-commit hook version-synced (hook output or docs evidence).
- **AC6** — full standing gate sequence green: format → analyze → test → coverage ≥ 80% → crap4dart check --all → crap4dart analyze → agents suite (unchanged by this bump).

## Test plan
- **UT-1:** config parse: `crap4dart` reads repo `crap4dart.yaml` under 0.14.2 (exit 0, threshold echoed 8.0). (AC3)
- **IT-1:** CLI surface smoke on a fixture tree: `check --staged` on a staged clean change (exit 0) and on a staged CRAP-heavy fixture (exit 2) — proves the exit-code contract is preserved. (AC2)
- **IT-2:** coverage chain: `analyze --coverage=` consumes the lcov produced by the current quality.yml filter chain. (AC2, AC6)
- **E2E-1:** the PR's own CI run = the real gate on the real tree with 0.14.2. (AC2, AC6)
- **REG-1:** CRAP-score drift guard: max CRAP before vs after on main — equal or better, else the delta is enumerated (never silent). A red REG-1 blocks merge even when all other jobs are green. (AC4)
- **REG-2:** agents suite result identical baseline (751/751-class pass) — the bump must not touch the runtime. (AC6)

### Edge cases
- **E1** — 0.14.2 rejects `crap4dart.yaml`: migrate config in-PR, threshold byte-identical (I1); if migration impossible, fallback rule applies.
- **E2** — CRAP math changes flag EXISTING code > 8.0: file follow-ups, do not bump threshold (I4); gate stays red only if follow-ups are not acceptable to the owner — escalate, don't decide alone.
- **E3** — pub global activate fails on CI's dart SDK (SDK constraint): pin the tool's compatible dart SDK in the same PR, document in PR body.

## Non-goals
- No threshold/exclusion/gate-order changes. No CRAP refactors of flagged code (follow-ups). No switch to a different CRAP tool.

## Open questions
- None blocking; if 0.14.2 proves incompatible (E1/E3), the fallback question goes back to the owner with evidence.

- AGENTS.md (pin-sync rule, gate sequence), GOAL.md Phase-0/2 (threshold law)
- Pin site: `.github/workflows/quality.yml:258`
- Upstream: https://pub.dev/packages/crap4dart (latest 0.14.2)

Dart-side edit race lesson: two edit calls against the same file in one parallel tool block = lost update — always sequential.         run: |

              :
